name: safe-cap-table-mcp
description: Model any startup round in seconds: post- and pre-money SAFEs (cap, discount, MFN), convertible notes, priced rounds, multi-tranche and extension rounds at different caps, option pool top-ups (pre vs post-money) and advisor/placement fees. Returns before/after cap tables, per-holder dilution and fully diluted ownership, validated against YC's standard SAFE examples. Works for any market.
